title: Tessera controls audit: analysis and editable sources
description: Standalone analysis/source archive preserving evaluated Tessera code, immutable protocols and run locks, saved primary and patient-held-out transfer evidence, controls, exploratory HER2ST comparator extensions and the colorectal pilot. Includes corrected manuscript sources and final PDFs with author-generated breast coordinate maps. No 10x breast H&E image/background is redistributed. Author-owned software is MIT; authored text and result aggregates are identified as CC BY 4.0, while third-party measurements, annotations and dataset-licensed CRC images retain source-specific rights. Saved-evidence verification and its documented limits are distinct from full experimental refitting.
notes: The software DOI is reserved until the record owner publishes. The evaluated original implementation DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23101191 archives a distinct earlier software product and does not archive later controls or presentation replacements. No manuscript DOI is asserted here.
